shared_elements: arc / crescent-shaped line with attached short strokes
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, schematic incised line-work, and each includes long curved/crescent lines with short strokes attached along them (the crew-strokes of A's boats, the banded girdle-like arcs on B), which is the only concrete correspondence. Otherwise the content differs fundamentally: A shows a stacked series of repeated vessel-like motifs with upturned prows across an open surface, while B shows a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure whose back bears axially symmetric ornaments including a prominent ring/disc and spiral-like elements, none of which appear in A.
